package_info.package_name: pyrologin, easytimestamp, discorder, discord-dev, style.py, pythonstyles
package_info.package_versions: all versions published between Dec 22 and Dec 31 (2023)
package_info.why_malicious: These packages install information-stealing and remote access trojan (RAT) malware, leveraging Cloudflare Tunnel to bypass firewalls, exfiltrate sensitive data, establish persistence, and provide attackers with remote control over infected systems.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Decodes and executes a PowerShell script that downloads a ZIP file from a remote server, unzips it, and installs additional dependencies and Python packages for remote control and screenshot capture.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Decoding and executing a hidden PowerShell script during installation is a classic malware tactic to evade detection and run arbitrary code.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: setup.py should only handle package installation, not execute obfuscated scripts or download remote payloads.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Rarely, some legitimate packages may download dependencies, but not via obfuscated PowerShell.
key_indicators: Silent error handling to avoid detection

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Downloads a ZIP archive from a remote server and extracts it to a temporary directory.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Downloading and extracting remote files during installation is a common malware delivery method.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Installers should not fetch and execute arbitrary remote code.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Silently installs additional Python packages to support remote access and tunneling.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Installing extra packages without user consent, especially for remote access, is highly suspicious.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Installers should not add unrelated dependencies.
key_indicators: Silent installation of remote access dependencies

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Steals browser cookies, passwords, crypto wallets, Telegram and Discord tokens, zips the data, uploads it to transfer.sh, and pings an onion site to confirm exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Harvesting and exfiltrating sensitive user data is a hallmark of infostealer malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages should never access or transmit user secrets.
key_indicators: Access to browser and wallet data

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: launches four threads: persistence, onion ping, keylogger, data theft
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Establishes persistence, pings onion site, starts keylogger, and initiates data theft.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Multi-threaded persistence and keylogging are advanced malware behaviors.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not establish persistence or log keystrokes.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Installs and runs Cloudflare Tunnel client
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Sets up a Cloudflare Tunnel to allow remote access to the infected machine, bypassing firewalls.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Cloudflare Tunnel is abused to provide stealthy remote access.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages do not expose local machines to the internet.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Flask app routes: run shell commands, exfiltrate files, execute Python code, remote desktop feed
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Implements a RAT: runs shell commands, exfiltrates files, executes arbitrary code, and streams a live desktop feed.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Full-featured RAT capabilities are highly malicious.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No legitimate package should provide remote shell or desktop streaming.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Implements a live remote desktop feed and captures user input (mouse clicks, keypresses) for the attacker.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Live screen capture and input logging via web interface is a RAT hallmark.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No legitimate web interface should stream a victim's desktop or capture input without consent.

attack_chain.action: User installs malicious PyPI package, triggering setup.py
PowerShell script downloads and extracts ZIP payload
attack_chain.leads_to: Installation of dependencies and execution of payload

attack_chain.action: Installs Flask and flask_cloudflared for remote access
server.pyw launches threads for persistence, keylogging, data theft, and onion site ping
Stolen data is zipped and exfiltrated to transfer.sh; onion site ping confirms exfiltration
Cloudflare Tunnel client is installed and started, exposing local RAT to the internet
Flask-based RAT provides shell, file exfiltration, code execution, and live desktop feed
attack_chain.leads_to: Full attacker control over victim machine

behavioral_signatures: Obfuscated or base64-encoded payloads in setup.py
Unexpected installation of Flask or flask_cloudflared
ZIP file download and extraction from remote server
Data exfiltration to transfer.sh or onion sites
Flask app exposing shell, file, or desktop access
file_indicators: setup.py with base64 or PowerShell code
Extracted ZIP files in temp directories
network_indicators: Unexpected traffic to Flask web server endpoints
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for obfuscated or encoded payloads in setup.py, unexpected PowerShell execution, and installation of Flask/flask_cloudflared. Flag downloads of ZIP files from untrusted sources and connections to transfer.sh or onion domains. Detect persistence mechanisms and keylogging activity. Watch for Cloudflare Tunnel client processes and Flask apps exposing remote access endpoints. Use EDR and network monitoring to correlate these behaviors.
